items.headline: Breaks $86k (+~3.2% vs Thu print); ETF tape flips back to +$103M
bullets: BTC ~$86,623 (Yahoo Fri AM CT) — clears the multi-session $82.5–85k box after Wed’s fade. CryptoSlate/The Block: U.S. spot ETFs +$102.7M net on Oct 1 (Farside), reversing Wed’s −$148.7M; IBIT led (+~$196M) while FBTC/GBTC still redeemed. Citi 12-mo target lifted to $113k (reports).

Next test is Sep NFP (08:30 ET). Holding $86k through payrolls + another green ETF day would confirm the reclaim; a snap-back under $84–85k would re-box the range. 10y still ~5.24% — real yields remain the macro choke.

items.headline: Thu Hormuz/China-export spike fades; WTI ~$90 / Brent ~$100 on Yahoo Fri AM
bullets: Yahoo CL=F ~$89.87 / BZ=F ~$99.97 Fri AM CT after Thu settles ~$92.87 / ~$102.31 (carrier + China fuel-export halt headlines). Reuters overnight: Brent briefly >$102 on WSJ third-carrier + China refined-export curb; Kpler/desks still cite Hormuz crude flows recovering (~13+ mb/d) while diesel/product remains the sticky channel.
Polymarket Hormuz normal by Dec 31: Yes ~20.5% / No ~79.5%. Brent–WTI ~$10 on this Yahoo print — product/security premium still in the curve even as the overnight crude bid gives back.

items.headline: Oct FOMC hold ~74–75% into NFP; 10y ~5.24% (−5 bp vs Thu desk)
bullets: Polymarket Oct 28–29 FOMC: No change ~74.5% / +25 bp ~24.5% (was ~63.5/35.5 yesterday). Another 2026 hike Yes ~75.5% (was ~81.5%). Soft Aug PCE + Williams/Goldman December-lean keep October as a hold base case into the print.
Calendar (CT): Sep NFP 07:30 — consensus ~90–98k, UE 4.1%, AHE ~0.3% m/m / ~3.2% y/y. Hot 130k+ / firm wages would reprice Oct hike odds and push 10y back toward 5.3%. Copper ~$6.56/lb. MUEL ~$454.

items.headline: Brazil race tight into Oct 4; Greenwald flags Moraes/Master as election risk
bullets: Polymarket overall winner: Flávio Bolsonaro ~55% / Lula ~44.5% / Renan ~0.15% (live ~Oct 2 CT). First round Sunday Oct 4; runoff path still the base case. Valor (Oct 2): STF crisis + Banco Master scandal dominate the campaign narrative — PL slogan “Moraes is Lula, Lula is Moraes.”

Glenn Greenwald (X/@ggreenwald): argues Moraes/Master payments and judicial overreach reshape the Lula–Flávio contest and democracy risk — https://x.com/ggreenwald/status/2072653327947452899 (also Substack framing: greenwald.substack.com/p/the-fall-of-brazils-tyrannical-judge). Desk: watch disqualification / STF moves as path risk vs tape.

items.headline: Winter energy campaign continues: Kyiv bridges + six oblasts without power
bullets: Follow-through after Sep 30–Oct 1 Trypillia/Kyiv grid package: Ukrenergo (Oct 2 AM) — emergency outages in Donetsk, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Mykolaiv, Kharkiv, Chernihiv; consumption +3.9% vs prior day. ABC/AP: three Dnipro bridges in Kyiv partially closed after drone hits — new disruption tactic beyond substations.
Sybiha (Thu, embargoed Fri): Kyiv open to combined energy + Black Sea ceasefire proposals (US/India/Turkey/Egypt floated). Zelenskyy out by YE2026 Polymarket Yes still ~5.5%.

items.headline: Holds ~$4,208 into NFP; SHA still +$14 (Sep 30 SGE row)
bullets: GC=F ~$4,208 (Yahoo Fri AM). Tape mixed into payrolls — Yahoo Finance desk notes Dec gold ~$4,210 open; some Asia prints softer on USD/yields. Soft PCE + higher Oct hold odds support the bid; a hot NFP that lifts 10y is the near-term risk back toward the ~$4,100–4,150 washout zone.
Shanghai (FindBullionPrices): latest SGE trade date still Sep 30 — SHAU AM $4,187.71 vs COMEX $4,173.59 → SHA +$14/oz. Mild China premium unchanged.

bullets: Polymarket ECB Oct 2026: No change ~90.5% / +25 bp ~10.5% (firmer hold than yesterday’s ~87–88%). Deposit rate 2.50% post–Sep hike; Europe remains the refined-product short under Hormuz product tightness.
French 2027 (Polymarket): Le Pen ~44% / Philippe ~20% / Mélenchon ~13% / Lisnard ~8%. Dutch PM market resolved (Jetten) — no live NL race; desk note stays.
